verdict.rationale: Workspace documents its own automatic user provisioning: changes to Workspace user accounts sync automatically to third-party apps such as Office 365 (docs-13, docs-26). That covers the directory-to-app-assignment leg of the story. The HRIS-as-source-of-truth leg has no evidence: the Directory API, Cloud Identity API and Apps Script are only developer building blocks for building such a sync, and dynamic groups are only an adjacent feature. Missing for 10: a native inbound HRIS connector or SCIM ingestion making the HR system authoritative, automated joiner/mover/leaver handling driven by HR attribute changes, attribute-driven app assignment tied to HR data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
